title: P18.2 Planner Adaptive Retry — cross-run canonical rejection feedback into the next delegated planFn INITIAL
description: A plan rejected by canonical validation previously parked the work item with zero learning. This adds cross-run adaptive retry: (1) planner-adaptive-retry.ts — pure-read plannerAdaptiveRetryForWorkItem deriving the newest terminal validation rejection for a work item from cost_reservation lineage + settled planner_attempt rows (VALIDATION_CODE/REASK/DROP_/DEP_/REPAIRED_ sanitized markers only, charset+length bounded; WINNER_SELECTED ends the episode; RUNNING residue skipped; transport/eligibility failures never count); cap PLANNER_VALIDATION_REPAIR_MAX=2 repair runs. (2) planner-pool.ts — priorRejectionContext opt re-validated defensively, fed to every candidate's INITIAL invocation (origin PRIOR_RUN), PRIOR_REJECTION:<code> marker protected and merged into all settles. (3) plan-preview.ts — bounded record warnings persist on STARTED rows. (4) business.ts — prepareDelegatedPlan throws FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_VALIDATION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED (typed PolicyError + durable work_item event) before minting a run when exhausted; forwards prior_rejection in expandCtx. (5) serve-mission-control.mjs threads expandCtx.prior_rejection into runPlannerFailover. (6) llm-planner.ts — PlannerRejectionContext.origin + PRIOR_RUN prompt phrasing (same sanitize bounds). (7) brain-context/reasoning-brief — feedback_informed telemetry on existing planner section/facts. Zero new authority; corrected plans pass the identical canonicalize+validation path; no executor dispatch before validation.
